subject: SIG intake: staffing, evidence sprint, and demo environment ops
messages:
From: Anna Gomez <anna.gomez@larktech.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: security@larktech.com, jmiller@larktech.com
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake + demo environment request

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — LarkTech is ready to kick off the SIG/CAIQ intake. We'd like to combine the questionnaire review with a short demo of the environment where you process inference requests, plus a quick walkthrough of log/retention samples.

Can we schedule a 60–75 minute session next week that covers:
- SIG/CAIQ question triage (we have a prioritized subset)
- Evidence owners & how we'll transfer artifacts
- Demo of a sample inference trace and log retention configuration
- Access method for temporary read-only artifact pull (S3 role or secure upload)

Attached is our initial question pack (larktech-sig-questions.pdf) — a handful are time-sensitive (audit window in July). Please propose times.

Anna Gomez
Head of Security Operations | LarkTech
anna.gomez@larktech.com | +1 415 555 0198

Attachment: larktech-sig-questions.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Anna Gomez <anna.gomez@larktech.com>
Cc: security@larktech.com, jmiller@larktech.com
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake + demo environment request

Hi Anna — great, thanks for sending the pack. We can do that. Proposed slots (PDT):
- Wed 2026-06-24 10:00–11:15
- Thu 2026-06-25 13:00–14:15
- Fri 2026-06-26 09:00–10:15

Agenda I suggest: 1) intake/triage (30m), 2) demo infra & logs (20m), 3) evidence handoff + owners (15m), 4) next steps/risks (10m).

Prep & asks for LarkTech before the call:
- Identify two evidence owners for platform and data flows (names + emails)
- Confirm whether you want S3 role-based access or a one-time secure upload link for artifacts
- Highlight any questions in the attached PDF that are blockers for your July audit so we can prioritize them

I'll assign internal owners for evidence collection and for the demo environment (infra + logs). Attaching a short prep doc that lists the artifacts we'll likely surface from our side.

Thanks — Jon

Jonas Weber
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 646 555 0123

Folks — forwarding LarkTech's intake. Can you help staff this and confirm owners? Quick notes / asks: 

> On Tue, 23 Jun 2026 at 09:12 AM Anna Gomez <anna.gomez@larktech.com> wrote:
> > Attached is our initial question pack (larktech-sig-questions.pdf) — a handful are time-sensitive (audit window in July).
> >

Priority items we should own before the call:
- Marissa: evidence sprint owner (collect sample logs, CAIQ mappings, SOC2 artifact pointers). Target: have samples uploaded to shared Drive by Thu EOD 6/25.
- Irene: demo & infra owner (prepare a 10–15m guided trace showing request path, KV cache behavior, and retention config). Also prepare S3 read-only role example and a brief writeup on where we redact PII in logs.

I'll coordinate scheduling and send the invite once LarkTech confirms a slot. Also note they flagged an audit window in July — treat anything marked 'audit-blocker' in their PDF as high priority.

Jon

1) Evidence sprint (Marissa) — collect artifacts and upload to Drive folder linked below. Expected uploads by 6/25 5pm PDT: sample access logs (7 days), anonymized request traces (3 examples), config export for retention policy.

3) LarkTech to confirm evidence owners — Anna noted she'll provide names during the call.

Attachments: sample-logs-readme.txt (text/plain) — includes the file naming convention we'll use for the Drive upload.
